title: BMW Service Advisor
description:
About the role

We have an excellent opportunity available for a highly motivated, experienced Service Advisor to join our team at Sytner BMW Swansea.

As a Sytner Service Advisor, you will provide outstanding customer care and be the vital link between our customers and the workshop. You will inform and consult on vehicle servicing and repairs, and keep the customer up to date at every stage whilst answering any queries they may have. You will liaise with technicians/workshop control about the status of vehicles and ensure that work is completed on time. You will also have the ability to give the best advice on our products and services to our customers to ensure all their vehicle maintenance needs are met.

This is a busy, challenging role where customer care always comes first. You will be driven and self-motivated but take the time to talk to people, build genuine rapport and identify exactly what our customers want and need.

Sytner Service Advisors work a variety of flexible patterns which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

It is essential to have previous experience as a Service Advisor, although this does need to be within a premium brand. Training is provided through our dedicated in-house Learning & Development team and through outstanding manufacturer courses run by BMW to support your development in the role as well as your long-term career aspirations.

You will require excellent organisational and administrative skills along with good attention to detail and must have the ability to manage your time well. A strong customer service background would be beneficial as you will be required to delivering high levels of customer satisfaction in a very busy and demanding environment. Working knowledge of Kerridge would be advantageous, but not essential.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:

You will be joining an established business with a busy finance function, where an opportunity has arisen for a Finance Assistant to join the team.This is an excellent opportunity for someone with transactional finance experience who is looking for a varied position covering Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and wider finance duties, with the opportunity to gain exposure to month-end and year-end processes.Your new role

- Reconciling supplier statements and dealing with queries
- Assisting with weekly payment runs
- Raising and issuing customer sales invoices
- Monitoring outstanding debts and following up on overdue payments
- Allocating customer payments to the correct accounts
- Resolving customer queries relating to invoices and payments
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records within the accounting system
- Supporting month-end and year-end finance processes

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience within a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar transactional finance position
- Experience across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and reconciliations
- Good working knowledge of accounting software
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables and VLOOKUPs
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise your workload
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive approach to problem-solving
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team and liaise with other departments

Desirable
- AAT Level 2 or an equivalent finance/accounting qualification
- Approximately 1-2 years' experience within a transactional finance role
- Knowledge of UK financial regulations and VAT

What you'll get in return
- A varied Finance Assistant opportunity covering both Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
- Broad exposure across transactional finance
- Involvement in month-end and year-end processes
- Exposure to journals and reconciliations
- Opportunity to develop your finance experience within a wider finance function
- The chance to work collaboratively with colleagues and other departments

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'Apply Now' to submit your CV, or contact William Loring at Hays Accountancy & Finance for a confidential discussion.If this role isn't quite right for you, but you're considering a move, please get in touch to discuss other finance opportunities across South Wales.

title: Test Administrator (TIMSS) - Wales - Fully Remote
description:
Background

Pearson is responsible for the delivery of the TIMSS international assessment study in schools in Wales.

The Trends in Maths and Science Study (TIMSS) is an international comparative study that assesses and compares the performance in maths and science of pupils at age 10, or Y5 in Wales, every four years across about 60 countries. It provides internationally comparative data on pupils' achievement in maths and science, and how their performance is related to their attitudes, gender and background . More information on the study is available online:

Pearson is recruiting external Test Administrators (TAs) to administer this study in schools in Wales.

The pupil assessment is split into two test sections followed by a questionnaire section. Test Administrators will need to be confident using technology however, training will be given on accessing and using the online platform. Schools are also asked to have an IT technician available on the day. Online remote TA training is mandatory to ensure standardisation in the delivery of the study's requirements.
Purpose

Test Administrators administer pupil assessments and questionnaires online within designated schools, ensuring that the international procedures are adhered to in full. Successful applicants for this role will be trained remotely on the procedures and must complete pre-training activities and attend a live training/Q&A session in the two to three weeks prior to the test window. Preparation for the training session will include reading the TA manual and completing short online assessments on aspects of the pre-training materials.
Main Responsibilities
- Liaise with the School Coordinator or Headteacher regarding arrangements for the test day, such as room bookings and desk/table layout of the room/s to be used and access to IT facilities, as needed.
- Ensure there are enough computers / laptops on the assessment day for all pupils.
- Ensure that pupils are sitting their assigned assessment.
- Administer the assessments and pupil questionnaire in accordance with international standards as outlined in the training and instructions provided, maintaining test security at all times.
- Ensure the correct timing of the sessions, recording the session start and end times.
- Record pupil participation and complete appropriate administrative paperwork as outlined in training.
- After completion of the pupil assessments and questionnaires, ensure administration documents are returned to Pearson.
- Ensure schools are reminded that teacher and school questionnaires need to be completed by the test date.
- Set up and administer devices supplied by Pearson (laptops), in schools where this is needed, following the guidance given.
Relevant Experience
- Experience of teaching and / or working in a school classroom.
- Confident using IT applications, particularly for onscreen assessment.
- Experience of invigilating tests / examinations.
Competencies Required
- Ability to adhere to specified procedural standards.
- Confident troubleshooting common technology user issues.
- Excellent verbal communication skills.
- Good organisation and administrative skills.
- Ability to identify, communicate and escalate issues promptly and effectively.
- Ability to work to agreed timeframes.
Essential Requirements
- Availability for the study as per the following:

o remote TA training 29 Apr 2027 15:00 - 17:30

o test window 17 May to 2 Jul 2027 Mon to Fri to visit c. 2-3 schools per week
- Arrival time at school is usually 08.00 and finish time is approximately 13.00 (agreed with individual schools depending on local circumstances).
- Car and driving licence for travel to schools, as required (use of public transport is encouraged, where practical).
- If successful, we will apply for an Enhanced DBS certificate for you, covering working with children.
- Commitment to the safeguarding and welfare of all pupils.
Desirable Requirements

Overnight stays may occasionally be necessary to be at the school by 08.00.

Ability to deliver in the Welsh language will expand the number of potential schools you can visit.
